description: Search Morocco's national economic and social indicators from the HCP quarterly bulletin (monthly and quarterly series: consumer and producer price indexes by city, industrial/mining/energy output, tourism nights, external trade, exchange rates, public finances, Casablanca stock exchange, labour force, national accounts). Accepts French or English terms ("inflation", "indice general", "tourisme", "chomage", "euro"); optional topic filter. Returns ids with latest value; call ma_indicator_series for history. With no arguments lists the topics.

search.description: Words from the indicator name, French or English, e.g. "indice general", "inflation", "nuitees", "euro". All words must match.

topic.description: Optional topic filter (substring), e.g. "IPC", "Tourisme", "COMMERCE EXTERIEUR", "FINANCES PUBLIQUES". Listed by ma_bulletins.

name: ma_indicators
title: Ma Indicators
